about: Plain sentences a real person might type into the Wisdom Finder, each with the topic ids that would be a right answer (any one of them counts). Written before the matcher was tuned. The holdout set was written at the same time and not looked at while the curated phrases were written; the test reports both. Read by client/src/lib/wisdom-match.test.ts.
